bg.purpose: The page itself. Nothing content-bearing is allowed to sit directly on it — it exists to make white cards read as objects.

surface.purpose: Cards, dialogs, inputs, toasts. The working surface for all content.

surface-2.purpose: Table heads, row hover, card footers, inset wells and disabled fields. A recess, never a raise.

border.purpose: The default 1px division between everything. Depth is carried by borders first, shadow second.

border-strong.purpose: The edge of anything interactive at rest — inputs and buttons. Stronger than a division rule so controls read as touchable.

text.purpose: All primary content: headings, cell values, button labels. Measured 17.74:1 on card surface.

text-2.purpose: Captions, meta lines, table head labels, ghost buttons. Measured 7.56:1 on card surface.

text-3.purpose: Field hints, placeholders and disabled labels. The tightest pair in the system at 4.63:1 on the recessed surface — do not push it lighter.

navy.purpose: The single brand accent, and deliberately scarce: the top bar, the primary button, and the loading sweep. Nothing else. Kept from the earlier build by the operator's explicit request.

focus.purpose: The focus border plus a 3px rgba(59,130,246,0.18) ring. Distinct from navy so focus never reads as brand decoration. 3.68:1 against white, clearing the 3:1 non-text requirement.

success.purpose: Active households, claimed invites, completed acts. Always paired with #ecfdf5 and a #a7f3d0 border.

danger.purpose: Destructive acts, deletion-pending state, and failures. Nothing else, ever. Never used for mere emphasis.

warning.purpose: Awaiting action — chiefly a pending admin invite. Paired with #fffbeb and a #fde68a border.

info.purpose: Neutral notices in toasts. Paired with #eff6ff and a #bfdbfe border.

page-title.purpose: The h1 on every folio. 24px/600, tightened -0.011em.

section.purpose: An h2 dividing a page into named regions.

card-title.purpose: An h3, and the title inside a card header or dialog panel.

body.purpose: Prose, table cells, inputs and button labels. The default at 14px.

label.purpose: Form labels and field hints at 13px, weight 500.

caption.purpose: `small`, inline status and alert text, pagination range.

micro.purpose: Table heads and badges at 12px, and the top bar's uppercase tracked wordmark and nav links. Tracked caps are a chrome treatment only — never page content.

fonts.source: self-hosted variable woff2, weights 400-700, two subsets (latin, latin-ext), declared in src/styles/tokens.css with font-display: swap and explicit unicode-range
fonts.note: There is no display face and no second family by design. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, tracking and case. There is no weight 700 in use — 600 is the top step.
fonts.rampNote: Seven steps. --t-3xl is declared but no shipped surface renders it; it is reserved rather than deleted because the metrics grid is the obvious future consumer.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: The resting elevation: cards, inputs, buttons. Barely there — it lifts an already-bordered object off the ground rather than doing the separating itself.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: The loading sheet, which stands alone on the page with no sibling to be measured against.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Overlay elevation: dialog panels and toasts. Every shadow in the system is offset plus blur, tinted rgba(16,24,40,...) — never pure black, never a glow.

focus.name: ring
focus.purpose: The conventional ring, executed properly. The border recolours and a 3px translucent ring is added outside it, so nothing shifts and the control keeps its shape.
focus.fieldVariant: Identical for inputs, textareas and selects. An invalid field (aria-invalid="true", or an aria-describedby ending in -error) swaps the ring to rgba(180, 35, 24, 0.15) and the border to --danger.
focus.invertedVariant: Not defined. The navy top bar declares --focus-on-navy #93c5fd for controls placed on the navy field.
invertedRequiredFor: the sign-out control in the top bar
any new control placed on the navy field
focus.mandatory: Validation state is keyed off the ARIA attribute, not a class, so the accessible state and the visual state cannot drift apart. Style new invalid states the same way.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: State changes: hover, border-colour, colour. Applied to named properties only — never to `all`.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.value: 200ms, opacity 0 to 1 with translateY(8px) to none
motion.purpose: A toast arriving. A single damped rise, one axis.

motion.name: rule-sweep
motion.purpose: The waiting state, kept from the earlier build by request: a 38%-wide navy segment swept across a 4px round track. Loading is a rule being drawn, never a spinning circle.

extensions.motionGrammar: Motion confirms, it never entertains. Single-axis, damped, and caused by the operator — with the sole exception of the loading sweep. No spinners, bounces, glows, parallax or multi-axis transitions. Transitions always name their properties.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: The only breakpoint in the system. Page padding drops from 32px 24px 48px to 24px 16px 40px, table cells tighten to 12px, and card header/body/footer horizontal padding drops from 20px to 16px. Tables scroll rather than reflow.

grid.folio: main, max-width 1280px, padding 32px 24px 48px (24px 16px 40px under 768px). The top bar's inner content shares the same 1280px measure so the wordmark aligns with the page title beneath it.
grid.note: Every measure resolves through an --s* token. The legacy --space-* aliases survive only to feed the .mt-/.mb-/.gap- utilities kept from the previous system.

radii.name: --r-full
radii.purpose: Status badges, pagination pills, the loading rule. Fully round means status or progress, never a button.

declined.name: The Register
declined.description: A distinctive concept direction — ruled ledger-bone stock, engraved blue-gray hairlines, vermilion reserved for cancellation, hatched grace bars, no cards and no rounded corners (seed da764555). Built out in full and rejected by the operator in favour of the category standard. Do not reintroduce any part of it.

declined.name: Dark mode
declined.description: No dark palette exists. color-scheme: light is declared explicitly. Not attempted, not deferred — the console is a desk tool with one appearance.

declined.name: Tablet breakpoint
declined.description: Earlier documents described mobile/tablet/desktop tiers at 768px and 1024px. Only the 768px block was ever built. Desktop is the committed target, so the missing tier is a scope decision rather than an omission.

measuredContrast.note: Measured against the shipped tokens on 2026-08-20 and recorded as fact. No accessibility standard has been formally adopted for this product; these are measurements, not a compliance claim. Every text pair clears WCAG AA (4.5:1).

values.ratio: 4.63:1 — the tightest pair in the system

scope.note: Composed surfaces have their own stylesheet (signin.css, dashboard.css, households.css) alongside the shared components in header.css, console-layout.css and logout-modal.css. Inherited surfaces get the system through element and ARIA-role selectors in src/styles/console.css; their current appearance is correct base setting, not designed layout.

legacyNaming.note: Some class names survive from the rejected Register direction and are legacy names for conventional components, not a surviving metaphor. Rename freely; do not read intent into them.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one primary act on a page, sitting in the page header opposite the title. Navy fill, white label. Applied automatically to button[type=submit] and a[role=button], so most primary actions need no class at all.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Libre Franklin', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: #f8fafc; background: #2b3d4e; border: 1px solid #2b3d4e; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06); transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #22313f; border-color: #22313f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,.18); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { color: #6b7280; background: #f9fafb; border-color: #e5e7eb; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Destructive Action
components.description: Delete and other irreversible acts. Danger fill, white label, 6.28:1. Always opens a confirmation dialog rather than acting immediately.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: #f8fafc; background: #b42318; border: 1px solid #b42318; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06); transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #99200f; border-color: #99200f; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base container. Nothing content-bearing floats on the page ground — it goes in a card. Optional header (title left, action right, bottom rule) and footer (recessed fill, top rule).
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-card-header h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.011em; color: #111827; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; background: #f9fafb; border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A round pill carrying a 6px currentColor dot. Three variants map to the status pairs. A status colour never appears without its background and border — a bare red word is not a status.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge--neutral { color: #047857; background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #a7f3d0; } .ds-badge--warning { color: #b45309; background: #fffbeb; border-color: #fde68a; } .ds-badge--danger { color: #b42318; background: #fef2f2; border-color: #fecaca; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A labelled input with an optional hint. Invalid state is driven by the ARIA attribute so the accessible name and the visual state cannot diverge.
components.html: Up to 100 characters.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-field label { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #111827; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #111827; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d3d8de; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06); appearance: none; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-field input:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #b9c0c9; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,130,246,.18); } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #b42318; } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true']:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(180,35,24,.15); } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 13px; color: #6b7280; margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom-right stack. Each toast is tinted with its status pair and carries an icon in the status foreground — success, error and info must never be mistaken for each other.
components.css: .ds-toast-stack { position: fixed; right: 24px; bottom: 24px; z-index: 60; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; max-width: min(400px, calc(100vw - 40px)); } .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; color: #111827; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -8px rgba(16,24,40,.18), 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(16,24,40,.08); animation: ds-toast-in 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-toast-icon { display: flex; flex: none; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-toast--success { background: #ecfdf5; border-color: #a7f3d0; } .ds-toast--success .ds-toast-icon { color: #047857; } .ds-toast--error { background: #fef2f2; border-color: #fecaca; } .ds-toast--error .ds-toast-icon { color: #b42318; } @keyframes ds-toast-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

components.name: Loading Sheet
components.description: Signature, kept by the operator's explicit request. A centred white sheet on the page ground carrying a status line and a swept navy rule. Used for the session splash and the magic-link exchange. Loading is a rule being drawn, never a spinning circle. Do not redesign without asking.
components.css: .ds-validating { min-height: 100svh; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; background: #f6f7f9; } .ds-validating-sheet { width: min(400px, 100%); background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(16,24,40,.1), 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06); padding: 24px; } .ds-validating-sheet [role='status'] { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; color: #111827; } .ds-validating-rule { position: relative; height: 4px; background: #f9fafb; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-validating-rule::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 38%; border-radius: 999px; background: #2b3d4e; animation: ds-rule-sweep 1100ms ease-in-out infinite alternate; } @keyframes ds-rule-sweep { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(263%); } }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Signature, kept by the operator's explicit request. Navy field, uppercase tracked wordmark, uppercase nav links with a 2px underline on the active tab, operator identity and sign-out pushed right. Inner content shares the page's 1280px measure. Do not redesign without asking.
components.html:
Nostos Operator Console

DashboardHouseholds
components.css: .ds-topbar { background: #2b3d4e; color: #f8fafc; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.2); } .ds-topbar-inner { width: 100%; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; } .ds-topbar-mark { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f8fafc; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-topbar-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; margin-right: auto; } .ds-topbar-nav a { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: rgba(248,250,252,.72); padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-topbar-nav a:hover { color: #f8fafc; border-bottom-color: rgba(248,250,252,.4); } .ds-topbar-nav a.active { color: #f8fafc; border-bottom-color: #f8fafc; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: The role attribute is the overlay itself; its single child is the panel. Used for logout, delete and restore confirmations. Escape closes the logout modal only — the delete and restore dialogs have no Escape handler and none of the three trap focus. Both are known gaps, recorded in docs/FRONTEND.md §13.
components.html:
Delete this household?

It can be restored for 30 days.
components.css: [role='dialog'], [role='alertdialog'] { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 40; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 24px; background: rgba(17,24,39,.5); } [role='dialog'] > *, [role='alertdialog'] > * { width: 100%; max-width: 440px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px -8px rgba(16,24,40,.18), 0 4px 8px -4px rgba(16,24,40,.08); padding: 24px; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Lives inside a card, wrapped in an overflow-x container. Tables scroll on narrow viewports — they are never restacked into cards and columns are never dropped.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; } .ds-table-wrap table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; } .ds-table-wrap th { text-align: left; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #4b5563; background: #f9fafb; padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table-wrap td { padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; vertical-align: middle; color: #111827; } .ds-table-wrap tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-table-wrap tbody tr:hover { background: #f9fafb; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Centred, generously padded, secondary ink. Says what is absent and what to do about it.
components.css: .ds-empty-state { padding: 48px 24px; text-align: center; } .ds-empty-state p { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; color: #4b5563; max-width: 70ch; }

narrative.overview:
The conventional operator console, executed properly. It refuses metaphor, ornament and invention: an operator who has used any admin tool should need nothing explained. Familiarity is the commitment, not a retreat, and the craft bar is Linear and Vercel.

This is a chosen position, not a default. A distinctive direction — The Register, a ruled ledger in bone stock and vermilion — was designed and built out in full, then rejected by the operator in favour of the standard. Two elements were carried over from that build by explicit request and are not open for redesign: the navy top bar and the loading treatment.

Structure is carried by borders first and shadow second. Every surface is a white card with a real 1px rule, a small radius, and a shadow that only lifts it off the light neutral ground. Nothing content-bearing floats on the page. Navy is the single brand accent and is spent almost entirely on the top bar, so its scarcity is what makes it read as brand at all.

State is a pair, never a lone hue. Each status carries a foreground, a background and a border, and each means exactly one thing — red is destructive or failed, never merely emphatic. Type is a single face, Libre Franklin, self-hosted, with hierarchy coming from size, weight and tracking rather than a second voice. Motion confirms and never entertains: one authored moment per surface, single-axis and damped, with the loading sweep the only thing that moves without the operator causing it.
narrative.story: The operator arrives on an errand, scans cards or a table, acts, and gets a confirmation that cannot be mistaken for its opposite.
narrative.firstViewport: Navy top bar; page title with the primary action opposite; a four-up row of metric cards; two cards below carrying what needs action.
narrative.finish: Contrast is measured rather than assumed — every text pair clears AA, with text-3 on the recessed surface the tightest at 4.63:1. The remaining unfinished work is behavioural rather than visual: dialogs do not trap focus, only the logout modal closes on Escape, and focus is not restored to the trigger. Those are recorded as open items in docs/FRONTEND.md §13 rather than papered over here.
